inventory.visualPurpose: Purine metabolism: de novo, salvage, degradation with deficiency blocks
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Purine flow map: PRPP → de novo → IMP → AMP/GMP; salvage via APRT/HGPRT; degradation to xanthine → uric acid; ADA and HGPRT deficiency blocks marked; drug targets (allopurinol, rasburicase, pegloticase)

notes: Original KYP redraw preserves the source map's circular topology (PRPP hub, IMP branch point, HGPRT/APRT salvage arcs, XO degradation ladder to uric acid/allantoin) with both deficiency blocks (ADA→SCID, HGPRT→Lesch-Nyhan) and all four drug anchors at their exact steps.
